first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the concurrent declines in completion and activation, with prior evidence of improved time-to-value and first-week activation in self-serve/SMB accounts. The archived records should be verified because their evidence is highly consequential to choosing this route for sustainable qualified revenue, while their stated outcomes are primarily adoption proxies rather than long-term qualified-revenue outcomes.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, prioritizing the self-serve/SMB path. It directly targets both observed declines: exp_86 confirmed higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and better 30-day retention (+3%); exp_31 confirmed an SMB activation lift (+9%) and qualified-revenue lift (+4%). This is the strongest verified route to sustainable qualified revenue available this week. Guard against the conflicting SMB 30-day retention result in exp_31 (-1%) by making retention and qualified revenue decision metrics, not only completion or activation.
